description: Check any set of citations against the complete insc.one Supreme Court cross-citation index (1950–2026). Accepts INSC, SCR, SCC, AIR, MANU, or mixed forms (compact like 2026INSC668 or bracketed like [1950] 1 S.C.R. 88). Each row returns RESOLVED with its Universal Citation Rosetta (all parallel report forms), decision date, gate status, and the official e-SCR source; or NOT FOUND — fail-closed, with no silent fallback to unrelated cases. Optional year filter flags year mismatches. Up to 50 citations per call.

citations.description: Citations to verify, one string each, e.g. ["2026 INSC 668", "(1973) 4 SCC 225", "AIR 1950 SC 27"]. Max 50.

year.description: Optional 4-digit year the citations must come from (flags YEAR_MISMATCH rows).

name: check_cross_citations
